def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    seat = sandbox.get_swing_seat()

    pos = seat.position
    vel = seat.linearVelocity
    vx = vel.x
    vy = vel.y
    target_y = 11.7
    damping_start_y = 11.0  # Start damping to adjust x-position before reaching full height
    pivot_x = 10.0
    pivot_y = 10.0

    # Calculate vector from pivot to seat
    pos_rel_x = pos.x - pivot_x
    pos_rel_y = pos.y - pivot_y
    dot_product = pos_rel_x * vx + pos_rel_y * vy

    if pos.y < damping_start_y:
        # Pumping phase: apply force only when moving away from pivot and in the right direction
        if dot_product > 0 and vx > 0:
            sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(42.0, 0)
        else:
            sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(0, 0)
    elif pos.y < target_y:
        # Damping phase: reduce horizontal velocity to control x-position
        sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(-vx * 10.0, 0)
    else:
        # Target zone or above: apply no force to let swing naturally into the target
        sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(0, 0)
